meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找回之前的对话和项目背景
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要查阅过去的会话记录来继续工作。
copy.tagline_en: Search past memories to retrieve prior conversations and project context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to look back at previous chat records to continue your work.

howto.what: 装上后，当你问起过去的会话或项目记忆时，Claude 会先搜索 Claude-Mem 数据库，列出带编号的结果标题；再调用时间线查看上下文；最后只取你选中的几条，抓取完整详情。
howto.when: 当你提到“搜索记忆”“你还记得 X 吗”“上次会话做了什么”等，或想找回先前项目、决策、任务的上下文时触发。

say.text: 搜索一下关于登录认证的记忆。
say.note: Claude 会执行搜索并显示结果标题。

say.text: 查查我们上周修过哪些 bug。
say.note: 会按 bugfix 类型过滤观察记录。

say.text: 取出编号 11131 和 10942 的完整记录。
say.note: 批量获取这两条记忆的详细内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask about past sessions or project memory, Claude searches the Claude-Mem database, lists matching result titles with IDs, shows a timeline around interesting items, then fetches full details only for the selected IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search memory, say "do you remember X," "what did we do last session," or want prior-session context for a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search my memory for login authentication.
say_en.note: Claude will search and show result titles.

say_en.text: What bugs did we fix last week?
Fetch full details for IDs 11131 and 10942.
